g.text: DJR-MCP Finder v0 versus v0.1: remote-component development audit
Strict ultra-remote inference is blocked (qcov ≥80%, identity <20%: n=1 independent component).
Train-only cyclic component crossfit; BLAST-derived strata are descriptive and method-conditioned.
Open symbols: v0 or v0.1 missed actual 99.5% specificity in ≥1 fold; intervals use fixed calibration thresholds and exclude calibration uncertainty.
